title: Can movies be cursed?
summary: Josh and Chuck explore whether movies can be cursed, working from a HowStuffWorks article that debunks most movie-curse claims. They cover on-set deaths and injuries (Noah's Ark flood scene, The Charge of the Light Brigade, Twilight Zone movie helicopter accident), and then go through alleged curses: Poltergeist (deaths of Dominique Dunne, Heather O'Rourke, William Sampson, Julian Beck), The Wizard of Oz (Buddy Ebsen's aluminum poisoning, Margaret Hamilton's burns, Judy Garland's life, the so-called hanged Munchkin), Superman (George Reeves, Christopher Reeve), The Conqueror (fallout from nuclear tests in Utah and elevated cancer rates among cast and crew), The Omen (Gregory Peck's son, lightning strikes, the London Hilton bombing, a crash and the "Omen" street sign), Brainstorm (Natalie Wood's drowning and Christopher Walken), and the unmade films A Confederacy of Dunces and A Took (deaths of actors attached to them). The episode closes with a listener email from Bridget Foster in Melbourne and a Heaven's Gate podcast recommendation.

entities.name: The Charge of the Light Brigade

segments.title: Opening banter and tour dates
segments.summary: Hosts announce January 2018 Seattle and Portland shows, then chat about dentist hygienists and a Atlanta dentist shout-out before introducing the topic.

segments.title: Movie curse premise and on-set deaths
segments.summary: The hosts introduce the HowStuffWorks article debunking movie curses, then describe real on-set deaths: three extras drowning during the Noah's Ark flood scene, an extra impaled in The Charge of the Light Brigade, and the Twilight Zone movie helicopter accident.

segments.title: Poltergeist curse
segments.summary: The hosts examine the Poltergeist curse, covering the murder of Dominique Dunne, the death of Heather O'Rourke after filming, and the deaths of William Sampson and Julian Beck, and conclude these deaths do not support a curse.

segments.title: The Wizard of Oz curse
segments.summary: Accidents and tragedies on The Wizard of Oz: Buddy Ebsen's aluminum powder poisoning and replacement by Jack Haley, Margaret Hamilton's burns, the hanged Munchkin myth, Clara Blandick, Frank Morgan's car crash, and Judy Garland's studio-driven life.

segments.title: Superman curse: George Reeves and Christopher Reeve
segments.summary: The hosts discuss the alleged curse of playing Superman, covering George Reeves's life and death and Christopher Reeve's 1995 riding accident and paralysis, followed by Dana Reeve's death from cancer.

segments.title: Break
segments.summary: Short break before the next topic.

segments.title: The Conqueror and nuclear fallout
segments.summary: The Conqueror, starring John Wayne as Genghis Khan, was filmed in Utah near the Nevada Test Site. Cast and crew later had elevated cancer rates, which the hosts discuss along with the People magazine report and the family's skepticism about the link.

segments.title: The Omen curse
segments.summary: The Omen's alleged curse includes Gregory Peck's son's suicide, lightning strikes on two separate planes, the IRA bombing of the London Hilton, a near-miss private jet charter crash, the death of animal wrangler, and a 1970s car crash that killed special effects assistant Liz Moore, with the disputed 'Omen' street sign.

segments.title: Brainstorm and Natalie Wood's death
segments.summary: Brainstorm was Natalie Wood's last film. The hosts discuss her drowning in 1981 after a night on a boat with Robert Wagner and Christopher Walken, the 2012 change in cause of death to undetermined, and the Rebel Without a Cause curse idea.

segments.title: Serial killers and Heaven's Gate podcast
segments.summary: A digression about the 1976 murder of Sal Mineo and a discussion of serial killers in past decades, with a recommendation of a Heaven's Gate podcast narrated by Glenn Washington.

segments.title: A Confederacy of Dunces and A Took curses
segments.summary: The hosts cover the long development of A Confederacy of Dunces after John Kennedy Toole's death, with actors John Belushi, John Candy, Chris Farley, and Will Ferrell attached and deaths halting it, plus the parallel A Took project where Sam Kinison's dispute halted it after his fatal car crash. A 2017 Toole biopic starring Thomas Middleditch... [note: Thomas Mann] is mentioned.

segments.title: Listener mail from Bridget Foster
segments.summary: A listener from Melbourne, Australia, praises the show and says her family enjoys it, including her husband's ham radio episode. The hosts offer her and her family guest list passes for the Melbourne show.

segments.title: Sign-off and social media
segments.summary: Hosts give social media, email, and website information and sign off.
